body:
Adds `research/sync-twin`: exact closed-form cost of clock offset and jitter that a twin (all sensors on one simulated clock) does not model, for a two-sensor fused estimate of a smooth signal.

- Exact timing variance `g` (matched to 200k-draw simulation within 0.5%); real MSE of twin-designed fusion is `1 + ag/(b(a+b))` times its claim; worse than the reference sensor alone iff `g > a+b`.
- Sync budget and clock-randomisation range study.
- 10 unit tests, experiment script + results, whitepaper, BibTeX, README, homepage entry (`python site/build.py` prints ok).

Stylised: very smooth signal, static weights, no real logs.
